text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having overcome countless hardships, the 
day had finally arrived. The Grand Live 
had begun, and every stage was already 
said to be packed to the brim.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now, Part 2 begins. At last, the 
unveiling of "GIRLS' LEGEND U"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After exchanging a few words with <chrname>, I saw 
her off to the stage. All so that everyone 
in the venue would have a blast...!
